summary: Migrated legacy-netapp to node2 at legacy-netapp.service.lan:4180. Health and identity are preserved, both SO_REUSEPORT workers operate, exposure is limited to node2’s application LAN, the legacy firewall policy persists, and node1 is retired. Both nodes passed sequential restart persistence checks.
actions_performed: Copied the unchanged application source and identity state to node2.
Adapted only the launcher interpreter and application-interface setting for Ubuntu 24.04.
Enabled the two workers and stateful, rate-limited firewall on node2.
Updated the endpoint mapping on both nodes while preserving all unrelated hosts entries.
Stopped and disabled node1 workers and removed its live application firewall chain.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified recovery after changed boot identities.

evidence.requirement: Preserve endpoint health and identity on TCP 4180
evidence.summary: The stable hostname resolves to 10.100.225.11 and returns legacy-netapp-ok with the original migration-cohort-44 identity.
Two independent worker processes own separate sockets on 10.100.225.11:4180, the source enables SO_REUSEPORT, and both workers served the post-restart sample.

evidence.requirement: Expose only on node2 application LAN and retain firewall policy
evidence.summary: The listener is bound only to 10.100.225.11; the management address is not listening. Live rules preserve established/related acceptance, invalid dropping, app-interface/source scoping, 120/sec burst-240 admission, limited deny logging, and rejection.

evidence.requirement: Retire node1 listener and application firewall while preserving source
evidence.summary: Node1 workers and firewall service are inactive/disabled, no port-4180 listener or app firewall rule remains, and source/state files retain their original hashes.
Direct diffs show the only hosts-file change on either node was the endpoint address.
Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot-ID change from b40d61f4-be22-4beb-af4f-63b909740842 to 45ee9525-d356-4268-b431-3ab08f8496f6, and recovered final state.
